description: A deployment-job step that sets target.settableVariables is rejected (shared deployment step template).

patches.find:
displayName: Install pinned tools (${{ join(', ', parameters.tools) }})
    env:
      SAF_TOOLS: ${{ join(' ', parameters.tools) }}
    target:
      commands: restricted
patches.replace:
displayName: Install pinned tools (${{ join(', ', parameters.tools) }})
    env:
      SAF_TOOLS: ${{ join(' ', parameters.tools) }}
    target:
      commands: restricted
      settableVariables: none
